items.v20: 🔜 v0.3 — Cloud sync of naming rules

0.q: Does CineRename work on Mac, Windows, Linux?
0.a: Yes. Native app on Windows, macOS and Linux thanks to Rust and Tauri v2.

1.q: Is it compatible with Plex, Jellyfin, Emby?
1.a: Yes. CineRename produces names and a folder structure perfectly compatible with all major media servers.

2.q: Do my files leave my computer?
2.a: No. All processing stays 100% local. Only requests to TheTVDB, TVmaze and OpenSubtitles leave your machine, and only to fetch public metadata and subtitles.

3.q: Can I undo a rename mistake?
3.a: Yes. The History tab keeps every change and lets you undo in one click, even days later.

4.q: Does CineRename handle ZIP / RAR files?
4.a: Yes. CineRename reads inside ZIP and RAR archives to extract videos directly, no manual step.

5.a: Yes. CineRename exposes preview / rename / organize / auto commands for your NAS, Seedbox and Plex server pipelines.

6.a: CineRename detects multiple copies of the same movie based on quality (480p, 720p, 1080p, 4K), suggests the best version to keep and allows direct deletion via the context menu.

7.q: What about the future? (TMDB, AniDB, open source...)
7.a: If the app works well and finds its audience, I plan to add premium sources like TMDB or AniDB. If it's really successful, the app could even become open source with a donation-based model. This would allow integrating all the API keys that are currently blocked by commercial licenses!
